corpus/agentic_glaive.jsonl.selection: first 36 conversations with >=2 tool calls and first 16 with exactly 1, in A4 file order, whose rendered length under the A2 tokenizer is <= 1000 tokens

corpus/code_stdlib.jsonl.selection: every top-level public function with 12..1000 A2 tokens
corpus/code_stdlib.jsonl.source: CPython 3.14.4 Lib/ (operator, urllib.parse, genericpath, functools, gettext, stat, shutil, calendar, glob, locale, base64, heapq, posixpath, tempfile, uuid, pprint, linecache, tokenize, colorsys, bisect, textwrap, fnmatch, statistics, shlex, string, html, difflib, quopri)

corpus/indic_anudesh_prompts.jsonl.selection: first user prompt of the first N conversations per A4 user-language tag (hi:110, te:110, mr:110, ur:2, hi-Latn:40, kn:6, ta:6, bn:6); responses NOT copied (Llama-2 output licence). kn/ta/bn are included on purpose: A4 admitted them but the A2 tokenizer cannot encode their scripts

corpus/reasoning_synthetic.jsonl.selection: 70 short division traces + 70 multi-step budget traces

corpus/wikipedia_en.jsonl.selection: web: 44 general articles (>=1200 tokens, not lists/disambiguation; chosen by stable hash), leading whole paragraphs up to ~1500 tokens; stem: listed science/math titles, up to ~700 tokens; long_context: listed short articles, complete

eval/heldout.jsonl.selection: first 3 paragraphs per language with >=40 words, <=250 A2 tokens and no <unk> -> validation; 4 more English paragraphs from other articles -> OPUS proxy

eval/test_items.jsonl.selection: gsm8k test 0-5, humaneval 0-2, mmlu test 0-3, math500 first 3
eval/test_items.jsonl.source: chat-data-cleaning/data/eval/* (the eval sets A4 decontaminated against)

note: Written by tools/prepare_inputs.py at development time. run_demo.py reads only inputs/.
